facts.value: Human resources can be defined as division of business that involves finding, screening, recruiting, and training job applicants.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: Human resources, or HR, is crucial for all businesses to succeed as it helps companies adjust to a fast-moving business environment and the increasing demand for jobs.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: The term 'human resource' was coined by John R. Commons in his novel The Distribution of Wealth.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: HR departments are relatively new as they began developing in the late 20th century.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: The main goal of HR departments is to maximize employee productivity and protecting the company from any issues that may arise in the future.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: Some of the most common activities conducted by those working in HR include increasing innovation and creativity within a company, applying new approaches to work projects, and efficient training and communication with employees.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: Two of the most popular subdivisions of HR are Human Resource Management (HRM) and Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS).
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: The HRM route is for those who prefer an administrative role as it involves oversight of the entirety of the company.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: HRIS involves the storage and organization of employee data including full names, addresses, means of contact, and anything else required by that certain company.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online

facts.value: Some careers of those involved in the Human Resource field include enrollment specialists, HR analyst, recruiter, employment relations manager, etc.
facts.programme_association: Business Tourism Degree Concentration | ASU Online
